# NHS CBT Self-help Techniques

NHS Every Mind Matters presents practical anxiety self-help ideas inspired by CBT, including noticing thoughts, reframing unhelpful patterns, and taking manageable steps. The material is framed as self-help information rather than a replacement for professional care.

For this project, the page is used as a public support resource when users ask for reputable self-help reading, not as a basis for diagnosis or treatment claims.
